title: Climbing Stairs
contract: Count ways to climb n steps using moves of one or two steps, with 0 ≤ n ≤ 45. There is one way to climb zero steps: do nothing.
brute: emit("Choose the final step size","remaining",n);if(n<=1)return 1;return solve(n-1)+solve(n-2);
optimal: long previous=1,current=1;for(int i=2;i<=n;i++){long next=previous+current;previous=current;current=next;emit("Combine the two possible predecessor heights","height",i,"ways",current);}return current;
reasoning: Every valid path ends with a one-step or two-step move.
The two predecessor heights partition all paths without overlap, giving ways[n]=ways[n−1]+ways[n−2].
Use ways[0]=1 for the empty path. This convention differs from Fibonacci's F(0)=0 even though the recurrences look alike.
